editorial:
Imagine a world where a dead terrorist group suddenly comes back to life with a deadly virus. You get to follow Conan and his friends as they deal with a high-stakes mystery that moves from a lab explosion to a giant airship. The vibe is classic Detective Conan, blending kid-friendly humor with a real sense of danger. You will feel the tension as the clock ticks down and the heroes try to stop a biological attack before it is too late. It feels like a race against time, and the airship setting makes everything feel more intense because there is nowhere for the characters to run.

What really works here are the action scenes and the way the puzzle pieces fit together. The pacing stays quick, though some of the side characters can feel a bit unnecessary. If you love mysteries with a big scale, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the bright animation pop. If you are a big fan of the series, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call so you can rewatch those twists anytime.
endingExplained: You find out the terrorists were actually using the virus as a fake threat to hide their real plan. Conan discovers the true mastermind behind the Red Siamese Cats and stops them just before the airship crashes. He uses his gadgets to save everyone on board in a big, flashy finale. The mystery wraps up with the bad guys getting arrested and the dangerous bacteria being safely secured, leaving the city safe once again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves detective stories and high-flying action.
